newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyon-Satolas says Jan-Oct air cargo up 9.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Lyon-Satolas says Jan-Oct air cargo up 9.7 pct.

text.p: Airfreight traffic handled at Lyon-Satolas Airport in the first ten months of the year totalled 17,453 tonnes, up 9.7 percent on the same period in 1995, airport authority figures show.
United Parcel Service of America Inc, DHL Worldwide Express and TNT Express Worldwide each operate air cargo services at Lyon-Satolas.
In September 1996, UPS launched feeder flights between Lyon and three other French cities - Bordeaux, Toulouse and Nice - last month, using two-tonne capacity Beechcraft 1900 aircraft.
January-October 1996 postal traffic handled at Lyon-Satolas totalled 11,301 tonnes, up 1.1 percent on the first ten months of last year. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
